review: lacklustre. 7 Outis' effect on skills that reduce enemy clash power does is not that impactful anymore, and as a result, she is just not good at clashing. 7 Outis still provides a lot of good debuffs, although not that potent. Weakness Analysis is still pretty good. Has a certain place in Rupture teams. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Ebony Stem - Helps with Rupture application in the Rupture team which pairs nicely with already present Rupture in Seven Outis’s kit
